focus: Autonomous run complete — public proof ready
summary: One goal now triggers planning, multi-query live research, memory classification, automatic watching, wake, rehydration, action, and verified telemetry without stage clicks.

milestones.title: Connect the tools
milestones.detail: Public repository, live Nimble search, RawTree event write/read, and a running local model.

milestones.title: Teach the memory gate
milestones.detail: The four-state policy passes 8/8 representative cases and rejects malformed observations or model decisions.

milestones.title: Give memories a lifecycle
milestones.detail: SQLite persists every memory class; detailed evidence is archived before dormant context is removed.

milestones.title: Wake when the world changes
milestones.detail: A bounded Nimble adapter, typed condition engine, scheduler, retry isolation, and idempotent waking are implemented.

milestones.title: Let the agent act again
milestones.detail: Archived rationale and fresh evidence are combined, reevaluated, and applied to a persistent shortlist exactly once.

milestones.title: Prove it in three minutes
milestones.detail: The autonomous lifecycle, measured context reduction, live evidence, and public proof are complete.

nimble.detail: A real search returned two source URLs.

rawtree.detail: One connection-test event was written and read back.

activity.title: One-command autonomous run verified
activity.detail: Liquid planned and analyzed, Nimble returned 9 live sources, the scheduled watcher woke the memory, the shortlist changed, and RawTree read back all 11 events.

activity.title: Guided demonstration console complete

activity.title: Full lifecycle telemetry verified

activity.title: Rehydration and agent action complete
activity.detail: Historical rationale and fresh evidence can now restore a provider, reevaluate it, and update the shortlist exactly once.

activity.title: Autonomous watcher complete
activity.detail: Due SPOREs can now search through the Nimble adapter, evaluate typed facts, reschedule, and awaken exactly once.

activity.title: Archive-and-forget lifecycle complete
activity.detail: Detailed evidence is integrity-checked in local archive storage before it leaves the agent's working context.

activity.title: SQLite memory storage complete

activity.title: Strict memory validation complete

activity.title: Deterministic memory gate complete

activity.title: Development baseline finalized
